run_type: executed local validation of constructed artifacts; no new robot evaluation

trials.label: Untouched archived artifact
trials.intervention: No mutation; accepted in-band data does not establish completeness outside its scope.

trials.label: Invalid JSON
trials.intervention: Remove final closing brace; violates JSON grammar.

trials.label: Missing environment event
trials.intervention: Remove final consumer event but retain producer stream and selection counter.

trials.label: Duplicate environment event
trials.intervention: Append final consumer event without changing independent streams/counters.

trials.label: Independent counter mismatch
trials.intervention: Increment measured sampler counter only.

trials.label: Action with stale hash
trials.intervention: Change first consumer action value while retaining original hash.

trials.label: Producer/consumer action mismatch
trials.intervention: Change first consumer action and recompute its valid hash; producer stream stays original.

trials.label: Episode identity mismatch
trials.intervention: Increment episode task ID only; inference identities and task outcomes stay original.

trials.label: Outcome aggregate mismatch
trials.intervention: Replace overall success percentage with the opposite binary outcome; task/group outcomes stay original.

trials.label: Missing completed-result wrapper
trials.intervention: Remove overall result; remaining ledger alone cannot establish completed evaluator output.

trials.label: Reordered steps
trials.intervention: Swap first two consumer events; counts and action hashes stay valid.

trials.label: Duplicate chunk; balanced counts
trials.intervention: Append a measured inference and increment both counters; aggregate counts agree but schedule duplicates.

trials.label: Missing timing field/unit
trials.intervention: Rename first inference cuda_ms to duration, losing the declared clock/unit field.

trials.label: Warm-up after measured event
trials.intervention: Move first warm-up event to end; all event and counter totals stay unchanged.

trials.label: Joint action rewrite
trials.intervention: Change both first action streams and recompute hashes. Without an external expected-action reference, an internally consistent record cannot certify which action occurred.

trials.label: Unlogged preprocessing coverage
trials.intervention: Unchanged bytes; ask whether all preprocessing was accounted for. No independent expected-stage manifest or preprocessing cost is available. This is an unknown coverage query, not an invented measured omission.

trials.label: Unlogged rendering coverage
trials.intervention: Unchanged bytes; ask whether rendering costs were fully included. No independent stage-level rendering record is available. This is an unknown coverage query, not an invented measured omission.
